result.title: FireGate: Bounding Behaviour Change Before Training in Continual RL Fine-Tuning
result.summary: Fine-tuning a deployed language model on one task after another can change behaviour that should stay fixed, such as earlier skills, general chat or refusals. Today, such forgetting is found only after training, on the benchmarks someone chose to run. This work bounds, before training, how often its outputs change on chosen prompt distributions. FireGate places each task's update, such as a new LoRA, behind a gate, which is a classifier on the model's frozen lower layers that decides for each prompt whether the update is used. Where no gate fires, the model computes exactly what the old one computes. As a result, on any prompt distribution, every bounded behaviour score changes by at most the gates' firing rate there over a whole task stream. Calibrating each gate on unlabeled prompts of what must not change fixes that rate before training, with a PAC guarantee, whatever weights training produces. Forgetting is thus bounded by the gate's false-alarm rate, and its price is the gate's power: no update, gated or not, that changes as few protected outputs can change new-task outputs more often than the best test of that level tells new-task prompts from protected ones. On reinforcement-learning streams of up to five tasks, gated training keeps the earlier tasks and changes 3.3% of held-out chat responses, whereas ungated training changes 91.8%. Across seven models, the gain kept behind the gate follows its firing rate on new-task prompts, measured before training. The certificate covers the gated model as deployed, on the prompt distributions sampled for calibration, not against an adversary who searches for prompts that fire the gate.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FireGate：在持续 RL 微调中把每个任务的更新（如新 LoRA）置于门控之后，门控是作用于冻结底层特征的分类器，逐 prompt 决定是否启用该更新，并在未标注的受保护 prompt 上校准触发率，从而在训练前给出行为变化的上界；在最多五任务的 RL 流与七个模型上验证了门控对旧任务与拒答等行为的保持。
AI.relevance_reason: 逐输入门控加校准触发率、把「启用额外更新的频率」与行为偏移上界绑定的做法，可能为 LVR 中何时启用 latent 计算或停止的开关设计与其代价刻画提供借鉴；但该工作在纯文本持续微调场景，门控在视觉特征上的可判别性可供核查。
